name: signal-aggregates-frontmatter-values
description: The Signal + Values sections must aggregate the signals and values frontmatter fields across the week's work-session notes, and must honestly flag the values the week neglected rather than reporting only wins. Covers the mechanical slice of Step 3 only — prose quality is a human judgement, not asserted here. Note: a plain not_contains on an absent value name does NOT work, because correctly flagging a value as neglected also mentions it.
prompt:
My settings set work-summary.values to four values: candor, persistence, craft, teamwork.

Do NOT call any tools. My weekly review covers 2026-06-01 -> 2026-06-07. These are
the three work-session notes found in range, with their full frontmatter:

Note 1:
  date: 2026-06-02
  ticket: ABC-142
  theme: delivery
  category: support
  signals: [tdd, self-initiated]
  values: [candor]

Note 2:
  date: 2026-06-04
  ticket: ABC-155
  theme: investigation
  category: support
  signals: [research-first]
  values: [persistence]

Note 3:
  date: 2026-06-05
  ticket: null
  theme: artifact
  category: tech-enablement
  signals: [self-initiated]
  values: [candor]

Linear and GitHub corroborate: 2 support tickets closed, 3 PRs merged, no Slack
activity worth noting, and I worked alone all week with no design or PM contact.

Write the Signal section and the Values section only.

assertions.description: aggregates the tdd signal from note 1
aggregates the self-initiated signal appearing in notes 1 and 3
aggregates the research-first signal from note 2
names the value carried by two of the three notes
names the value carried by note 2
honestly flags the values the week did not evidence, per the surface-gaps rule
characterises the shape of the week from the theme and category fields
